name: Bioextrax
summary: Bioextrax AB (publ) focuses on developing and commercializing a groundbreaking, biology-driven extraction system. This advanced technology facilitates the recovery of a variety of valuable materials from bacterial origins, such as bioplastic granules (PHA), organic hydrolyzed proteins, keratin fibers, different bio-oils, protein-rich co-products, and amino acids. The firm was founded in 2014 and conducts its operations from Lund, Sweden.
